# platform-orchestrator_scim_group_mappings (Data Source)

Lists all SCIM group-to-role mappings in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_scim_group_mappings" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `mappings` (Attributes List) The SCIM group mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mappings`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The mapping creation time.
- `group_display_name` (String) The SCIM group's display name.
- `role_id` (String) The mapped role UUID.
